parole.testo: Borrowed from Latvian valoda (“language”). First attested in 1989 as воло́да (volóda), when the word was introduced by newspaper “Zbudinnje” into West Polesian microlanguage. By surface analysis, володі́ти (volodíty, “to own”) + -а (-a), literally “what they own and can speak”.
Borrowed from Latvian spars (“energy, vigour”). First attested in 1989 as спаре́з (sparjéz), when the word was introduced by newspaper “Zbudinnje” into West Polesian microlanguage.
